description: Oil and gas extraction cash-flow skeleton for SIC 1311 retaining all 237 supplied unique US GAAP concepts once. The supplied ConocoPhillips reference guides broad presentation. Cash versus noncash ARO, oil/gas capex and acquisition scopes, earnings adjustments, ownership cash and cash-population alternatives remain distinct; hierarchy defines no arithmetic.
classification_notes: All 237 supplied concepts appear once. The SIC inventory covers multiple issuers and accounting presentations and is not a claim that ConocoPhillips reports every concept.

The reference guides presentation only; its funds-from-operations and free-cash-flow captions do not create reported taxonomy concepts or supported calculations. No FFO, EBITDAX or FCF subtotal is manufactured.

Consolidated profit, parent net income and continuing income including NCI are alternative starting scopes. Continuing/discontinued section totals and all-discontinued cash overlap rather than form extra flows.

ARO cash paid to settle is generally operating per the official definition. Liabilities settled can include transfers/disposals, while additions, estimate revisions and rollforward changes include noncash events; none substitutes automatically for cash paid.

Accretion including ARO overlaps ARO accretion and AccretionExpense excluding ARO. Producing-activity impairment, accretion and dry-hole disclosures are supplementary rather than extra consolidated add-backs.

Oil/gas mineral-interest acquisition, equipment, exploration/development and general productive/PP&E cash views overlap. Separate capitalized/incurred recognition, unpaid capex and noncash consideration from cash expenditure.

Property, PP&E, broad assets, derivative/commodity and financial-service earnings results retain scope; they are not cash sale receipts. Unrealized reversals must concern earnings rather than OCI-only changes.
Equity-method operating return-on-investment distributions differ from investing return of capital; net-of-distributions earnings already contains operating distributions.

Borrowing priority, collateral, maturity, legal instrument and counterparty views overlap. Gross/net proceeds and issuance costs require matching scope; private placement does not identify debt versus equity.
OperatingLeasePaymentsUse concerns cash to bring another asset to intended use; issuer capitalization/section requires review before assigning to primary operating/investing flows.
Cash balances and FX effects preserve continuing versus total including disposal/discontinued scopes. Contractual debt rate and dividend/offer-cost balances are supplementary instant facts.
Every group explains shared overlap, while review reasons describe concept-specific issues. All contra flags are false and prescribe no source sign inversion or earnings reversal.

metadata_contract.period_type: Official US GAAP 2026 verifies 232 duration monetary concepts, 4 instant monetary balances and 1 instant percentage rate.
metadata_contract.unit_type: 236 monetary and 1 percentage concepts; cash balances, dividend payable, deferred offering cost and contractual rate retain their official units/periods.
metadata_contract.contra: False throughout; source fact direction, earnings add-back signs, currency and scale require issuer fact context.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 237 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts for SIC 1311.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

nodes.label: Operating activities
nodes.classification_note: Reported total organizes reconciliation families. Starting-income alternatives, scope totals and overlapping adjustments imply no arithmetic.

children.label: Income starting-measure alternatives
children.classification_note: Parent net income, consolidated profit and continuing income including NCI have distinct attribution/operation scopes; do not combine starting measures. Discontinued income is not itself cash flow.

children.label: Net income (loss) attributable to the reporting entity

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss
concepts.review_reason: NetIncomeLoss is parent-attributable while consolidated cash flow can include NCI; match the issuer indirect-method starting measure rather than substituting consolidated ProfitLoss automatically.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: Continuing income including NCI has a consolidated continuing-operation scope, unlike parent net income or total ProfitLoss including discontinued results; do not mix starting measures.

children.label: Income loss from discontinued operations net of tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTax
concepts.review_reason: Discontinued-operation income is net of tax and is not itself discontinued cash flow; match attribution and avoid deducting it from a starting measure already excluding it.

children.label: Operating cash-flow scopes
children.classification_note: Continuing and discontinued totals are scope details of total operating cash flow rather than earnings reconciliation adjustments.

children.label: Asset consumption and financing amortization
children.classification_note: Gross/net D&A, depletion and financing amortization overlap. Use issuer-reconciled aggregates or matched components, not a sum of every measure.

children.label: D&A aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: Net depreciation/amortization/accretion can contain all the component expense views below; the DD&A aggregate differs from depreciation alone.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet
concepts.review_reason: Net depreciation/amortization/accretion can contain oil/gas depletion, financing amortization, ARO and other accretion already supplied; reconcile the issuer component coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: DD&A can include depreciation and oil/gas depletion supplied separately and can overlap net DD&A/accretion; choose the issuer aggregate or reconciled components.

children.label: Asset consumption components
children.classification_note: Oil/gas depletion is a subset of total depletion and broad DD&A; lease ROU amortization can already be offset through lease reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Depreciation
concepts.review_reason: Depreciation can be part of DD&A and may also be allocated to exploration or production costs; do not duplicate the same add-back.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Depletion
concepts.review_reason: All depletion can contain the oil/gas-specific depletion supplied separately and be included in DD&A; select the issuer consumption scope.

children.label: Depletion of oil and gas properties

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepletionOfOilAndGasProperties
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas depletion is a component of total depletion and DD&A; match the same producing-asset population before using a separate add-back.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortizationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Operating ROU amortization can already be offset through lease liability changes and lease payments in the indirect reconciliation; it is not a separate cash payment.

children.label: Financing amortization alternatives
children.classification_note: Financing-cost-plus-discount amortization includes standalone financing cost and premium/discount adjustments; these are noncash expense adjustments, not issuance payments.

children.label: Amortization of financing costs and discounts

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCostsAndDiscounts
concepts.review_reason: Financing-cost-and-discount amortization combines amounts also supplied as standalone financing amortization and premium/discount amortization; select matching components or total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCosts
concepts.review_reason: Financing-cost amortization may be contained in the financing-cost-and-discount aggregate; do not add it to that aggregate or treat it as cash debt issuance cost.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfDebtDiscountPremium
concepts.review_reason: Debt premium/discount amortization can already be included in financing-cost-and-discount amortization; preserve premium-versus-discount earnings direction.

children.label: Accretion scope alternatives
children.classification_note: Accretion including ARO contains ARO accretion and other accretion. AccretionExpense excludes ARO explicitly; producing-only measures remain supplementary.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccretionExpenseIncludingAssetRetirementObligations
concepts.review_reason: This accretion aggregate includes ARO, environmental remediation and other contingencies and overlaps both standalone ARO and ARO-excluding accretion measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationAccretionExpense
concepts.review_reason: ARO accretion is noncash passage-of-time expense and can already be included in DD&A/accretion or broad operating adjustments; it is not ARO settlement cash.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccretionExpense
concepts.review_reason: AccretionExpense explicitly excludes ARO and is a component of AccretionExpenseIncludingAssetRetirementObligations; do not substitute it for ARO accretion.

children.label: Impairment and abandonment adjustments
children.classification_note: All-asset, oil/gas, unproved exploratory, leasehold and held-for-use/disposal impairment can overlap. Abandoned project costs can be part of these write-offs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: All-asset impairment may contain oil/gas, unproved exploratory, leasehold and other long-lived charges; select the aggregate or matched asset-class adjustments.

children.label: Impairment of oil and gas properties

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas impairment can include leasehold or unproved exploratory impairment and can already be in all-asset or long-lived impairment adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ExplorationAbandonmentAndImpairmentExpense
concepts.review_reason: This is impairment of unproved oil/gas properties, including unsuccessful/doubtful capitalized exploratory wells, and may overlap oil/gas impairment or project abandonment charges.

children.label: Impairment of long lived assets held for use

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-use long-lived impairment can contain oil/gas and leasehold charges and includes non-sale disposal situations; reconcile asset-class and total impairment coverage.

children.label: Impairment of long lived assets to be disposed of

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeDisposedOf
concepts.review_reason: Impairment of long-lived assets to be disposed of can overlap asset-class or total impairment adjustments; match the issuer disposal-group coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLeasehold
concepts.review_reason: Leasehold impairment writes down lessee use rights and can be included in oil/gas, exploration or long-lived impairment adjustments; identify asset and accounting scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncashProjectAbandonmentCosts
concepts.review_reason: Noncash abandoned project costs can include unproved exploratory impairment and broader oil/gas impairment; do not add the write-off twice.

children.label: Accounts receivable credit loss expense or reversal

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts
concepts.review_reason: Accounts-receivable credit loss expense differs from loan provisions but can be included in the broader loan/lease/other-loss total.

children.label: Share-based payment adjustments
children.classification_note: Noncash compensation expense can already be allocated in functional earnings and broad noncash reconciliation; issuance values and withholding cash are separate disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation
concepts.review_reason: Noncash share-based compensation may include allocated award and restricted-stock expense already supplied separately; select the issuer reconciliation amount without summing overlapping disclosures.

children.label: Earnings-result adjustments
children.classification_note: Earnings gains/losses are not cash sale/settlement receipts. Determine recognition and issuer reversal signs; overlapping instruments and realization scopes are alternatives.

children.label: Property and business disposal results
children.classification_note: Broad asset, PP&E, oil/gas, oil/gas-or-timber, residual and rental-property gains overlap only where asset populations match; discontinued results preserve tax scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1
concepts.review_reason: Broad disposal results can include oil/gas property, other PP&E, intangibles and business/equity-method disposals supplied separately.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of property plant equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment
concepts.review_reason: PP&E sale gains include oil/gas and timber assets and may contain separately reported oil/gas disposal results; they are not PP&E cash sale receipts.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of oil and gas property

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOilAndGasProperty
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas property sale gains can already be included in PP&E or broad disposal results; they differ from oil/gas property/equipment sale receipts.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of property

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProperty
concepts.review_reason: This property sale result specifically concerns oil/gas or timber property under its definition; it can overlap the oil/gas-only gain and is not a generic real-estate sale receipt.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of other assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other-asset sale gains are a residual within broad asset disposal results and may overlap specific property or investment gain adjustments.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of properties

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProperties
concepts.review_reason: This real-estate/property sale result covers property intended for sale, appreciation or rental; it is not automatically the same asset population as oil/gas sale gains.

children.label: Discontinued disposal result net of tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposalOfDiscontinuedOperationNetOfTax
concepts.review_reason: Discontinued disposal gains/losses net of tax differ from pretax disposal adjustments and cash divestiture proceeds; match the starting income scope.

children.label: Equity method investment realized gain loss on disposal

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method disposal gains can be contained in broad asset or investment disposal adjustments; they differ from cash proceeds of selling the investment.

children.label: Derivative and commodity results
children.classification_note: Fair-value, unrealized, sale, non-designated and hedging earnings overlap. Separate earnings from OCI and do not treat gains as settlement cash.

children.label: Derivative gain loss on derivative net

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeGainLossOnDerivativeNet
concepts.review_reason: Derivative fair-value changes recognized in earnings can overlap unrealized derivative/commodity measures and non-designated derivative results; they are not cash settlement proceeds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivatives
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized derivative results can be contained in unrealized derivative/commodity or all derivative earnings measures; reverse only amounts included in starting earnings, excluding OCI-only changes.

children.label: Unrealized gain loss on derivatives and commodity contracts

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivativesAndCommodityContracts
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized derivatives and commodity contract results can contain standalone unrealized derivative changes and overlap non-designated/hedging results; isolate earnings from OCI.

children.label: Net gain (loss) on derivatives not designated as hedges

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsGainLossNet
concepts.review_reason: Non-designated derivative gains can be included in overall derivative earnings and unrealized commodity results; designated hedges and OCI require separate scope checks.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfDerivatives
concepts.review_reason: Derivative sale earnings are not derivative settlement cash receipts and may be included in broader derivative results; identify the reversal included in issuer operating reconciliation.

children.label: Gain loss on oil and gas hedging activity

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnOilAndGasHedgingActivity
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas hedging earnings can overlap total derivative gains, non-designated derivatives and commodity valuations; hedge designation and recognition determine the reversal.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of commodity contracts

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfCommodityContracts
concepts.review_reason: Commodity contract sale gains are earnings, not cash sale/settlement proceeds, and may already be included in broader derivative or hedging results.

children.label: Debt, warrant, currency and investment results
children.classification_note: Debt extinguishment, warrant valuation, realized/unrealized FX and investment gains can be part of broad noncash adjustments; realized amounts require issuer reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants
concepts.review_reason: Warrant liability fair-value expense/income may already be included in broad noncash or financial remeasurement adjustments; it is distinct from commodity derivatives.

children.label: Foreign currency transaction gain loss realized

concepts.name: us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealized
concepts.review_reason: Realized foreign-currency earnings can already be included in broad noncash/other adjustments or operating settlements; do not reverse every realized gain without the issuer cash reconciliation.

children.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain Loss Unrealized

concepts.name: us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnrealized
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized transaction earnings differ from FX translation effects on reconciled cash; reverse only earnings included in the selected starting result.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized investment gains can be included in broad noncash adjustments but only earnings-recognized changes belong in an income-to-cash reversal; exclude OCI-only movements.

children.label: Equity-method earnings and operating returns
children.classification_note: Net-of-distributions earnings replaces corresponding gross earnings and operating return-on-investment distributions. Return of capital is investing and excluded from the net earnings tag.

children.label: Income loss from equity method investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method earnings differ from cash distributions and can be replaced by the net-of-distributions earnings adjustment; reverse only earnings included in the starting result.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentDividendsOrDistributions
concepts.review_reason: These equity-method distributions are operating return on investment under the definition and may already be netted in equity-method earnings; return of capital is a separate investing receipt.

children.label: Equity method income net of distributions

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestmentsNetOfDividendsOrDistributions
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method income net of distributions already includes operating distributions other than return of investment; do not also add the same gross earnings/distributions adjustments.

children.label: Tax expense adjustments
children.classification_note: Deferred expense differs from broader deferred taxes plus credits and balance rollforwards retained in supplements; net/gross measures must match issuer scope.

children.label: Deferred income tax expense or benefit
Deferred income taxes and tax credits

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxesAndTaxCredits
concepts.review_reason: Deferred taxes and tax credits are broader than deferred tax expense alone; identify included credit effects before selecting an operating adjustment.

children.label: Operating asset and liability changes
children.classification_note: Account movements are indirect-method reconciliations, not universal cash receipts/payments. Exclude acquisitions, disposals, currency and financing/investing balances before selecting components.

children.label: Operating capital aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: All operating capital and net other operating capital are overlapping aggregate/residual scopes; they contain narrower asset/liability movements.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingCapital
concepts.review_reason: Operating capital change is an aggregate of operating asset/liability movements and can include the separately supplied other-capital net and account changes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingCapitalNet
concepts.review_reason: Net other operating capital includes other operating assets less liabilities and overlaps their gross change disclosures; preserve issuer sign and select net or components.

children.label: Operating receivable changes
children.classification_note: Total, accounts-plus-other, trade, residual and interest receivables overlap; establish consistent portfolio and principal-versus-interest coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Total operating receivables can include accounts, other, interest and related-party balances supplied separately; select aggregate or matching components.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Accounts And Other Receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndOtherReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Accounts and other receivable changes contain trade/other components and may be included in total receivable changes; do not combine them with their components.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued interest receivable net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInterestReceivableNet
concepts.review_reason: Accrued-interest receivables can be included in other or total operating receivable changes; separate investing principal and acquisition effects.

children.label: Prepaid, inventory and other asset changes
children.classification_note: Combined prepaid/deferred/other assets overlap narrower prepaids and residual current/noncurrent assets; inventory is a distinct operating class.

children.label: Increase decrease in prepaid deferred expense and other assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidDeferredExpenseAndOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Combined prepaid/deferred/other asset changes can contain prepaid-only and other current/noncurrent asset movements; establish residual exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidExpense
concepts.review_reason: Prepaid-expense changes are included in the combined prepaid/deferred/other asset change where both are reported; select one matched view.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Other Current Assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other current asset movements can overlap broader other operating assets and combined prepaid/deferred/other changes; establish what the residual excludes.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Other Noncurrent Assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherNoncurrentAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other noncurrent asset changes may include investing/noncash movements or be part of other operating assets; validate the issuer operating reconciliation population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other operating asset changes can contain other current/noncurrent assets, prepaid or interest/other receivables; reconcile exclusions rather than importing unrelated insurance-specific components.

children.label: Operating payables and accrual changes
children.classification_note: Combined, trade, other-accrual and residual current/noncurrent liability views overlap; royalty, employee and interest details can be included in aggregates.

children.label: Increase decrease in accounts payable and accrued liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Combined payables and accrual changes contain separately supplied trade, royalty, employee and other accrual views; identify scope before combining details.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayable
concepts.review_reason: All accounts payable changes can include trade payables and be included in combined payables/accruals; do not count both aggregate and detail.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Accounts Payable Trade

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableTrade
concepts.review_reason: Trade payable changes are included in broader accounts-payable or combined payable/accrual movements; isolate the matching vendor population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accrued liabilities can include royalty, interest, tax and employee liabilities supplied separately; reconcile residual scope against combined payables/accruals.

children.label: Accrued and other operating liability change

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Combined accrued and other operating liability changes contain standalone accrued/other-liability views and potentially royalty/employee balances.

children.label: Change in Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other payable/accrual changes are residual within combined payables/accruals and can contain the other-accrual-only change; establish exclusions.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Other Accrued Liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other accruals may already be part of all accrued liabilities or combined other-payable/accrual movements; establish the residual exclusions.

children.label: Increase decrease in interest payable net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInInterestPayableNet
concepts.review_reason: Net interest payable changes may already be included in accrued-liability movements; isolate the interest component before using this detail.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInRoyaltiesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Royalty payable changes may already be included in accounts payable, accruals or other operating liabilities; exclude noncash acquisition or reclassification effects.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Employee Related Liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInEmployeeRelatedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Employee liability changes can include compensation/benefit accruals also in accrued and other liabilities; separate noncash award expense and payroll coverage.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Other Current Liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other current liabilities may be a subset of broader other operating or accrued liabilities and can include non-operating balances; establish residual coverage.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Other Noncurrent Liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherNoncurrentLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other noncurrent liability changes can contain financing, acquisition or noncash movements; use only the issuer-reconciled operating component.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other operating liability changes may contain royalties, employee balances or current/noncurrent residual liabilities; determine exclusions before combining narrower changes.

children.label: Operating tax balance changes
children.classification_note: Net income-tax payable/receivable movement overlaps income-tax-only payable/receivable and all-tax changes; these are not cash tax payments.

children.label: Income tax payables net of receivables change

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxesPayableNetOfIncomeTaxesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Net income-tax payable/receivable change contains narrower tax payables and tax receivable movements; do not combine net and gross views.

children.label: Change in accrued income taxes payable

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedIncomeTaxesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Accrued income taxes payable are a liability-only view that can be included in net tax payable/receivable changes and the broader all-tax movement.

children.label: Increase decrease in income taxes receivable
Increase Decrease In Accrued Taxes Payable

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedTaxesPayable
concepts.review_reason: All accrued tax payable changes may include income and other tax liabilities; they overlap income-tax-only and total accrual movements.

children.label: Related-party operating changes
children.classification_note: Accounts/receivable and payable relationship views overlap broader balances; exclude financing advances and investing loans before operating classification.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Due To Related Parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Related-party payable changes can contain operating accruals or financing advances; establish nature and exclude loan proceeds/repayments before operating classification.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Accounts Payable Related Parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Related-party accounts payable can be included in total accounts payable or broader related-party obligations; isolate operating trade balances from funding.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Accounts Receivable Related Parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Related-party accounts receivable are a subset of broader related-party or operating receivable changes; exclude investment-loan movements from the operating view.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Due From Related Parties

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromRelatedParties
concepts.review_reason: Related-party receivable changes can include operating trade balances or investing loans; identify issuer operating purpose before combining them with account changes.

children.label: Lease and deferred-revenue changes
children.classification_note: Lease liability changes include noncash additions/remeasurements and must reconcile with ROU amortization/payments. Deferred revenue changes can include noncash recognition.

children.label: Increase decrease in operating lease liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease liability changes include noncash commencements and remeasurements; reconcile with ROU amortization and lease payments rather than treating the entire balance movement as cash.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRevenue
concepts.review_reason: Deferred revenue balance changes can include noncash recognition or customer obligations and may be contained in operating liability changes; establish the issuer reconciliation basis.

children.label: Operating settlement and residual cash
children.classification_note: ARO cash settlement and operating lease payments may already be reflected by indirect-method liability adjustments; residual operating reconciliation is not an additional total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationCashPaidToSettle
concepts.review_reason: Cash paid to settle ARO is generally operating under the official definition; it may already be reflected in issuer reconciliation changes and is not additional to a matched cash settlement adjustment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeasePayments
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease payments may already be reflected by operating accrual/ROU reconciliations and include a different presentation scope from payments used to bring another asset to intended use.

children.label: Other operating activities cash flow statement

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingActivitiesCashFlowStatement
concepts.review_reason: Other operating activities is a residual cash-flow line, not an extra total above the specific operating cash flows and adjustments.

nodes.label: Investing activities
nodes.classification_note: Reported total organizes asset/investment cash flows. Accounting populations, gross/net and project views overlap; children are not automatically summed.

children.label: Investing cash-flow scopes
children.classification_note: Continuing/discontinued investing are details of total investing cash flow, not additional cash categories.

children.label: Oil/gas and productive-asset cash flows
children.classification_note: Acquisition, exploration/development, equipment and productive-asset views overlap. Cash spending differs from capitalized/incurred recognition and unpaid capex.

children.label: Oil/gas acquisition and development views
children.classification_note: Combined mineral interests/equipment includes property-only/equipment-only purchases. Exploration/development may already be part of issuer capex; avoid duplicating expensed exploration in operating and investing.

children.label: Payments to acquire oil and gas property and equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Combined oil/gas mineral-interest and equipment purchases contain the narrower property-only and equipment-only amounts and may already be included in PP&E purchases.

children.label: Payments to acquire oil and gas property

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProperty
concepts.review_reason: These payments purchase mineral interests used in oil/gas operations and exclude equipment; they can already be included in the combined oil/gas property/equipment cash purchase.

children.label: Payments to acquire oil and gas equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas equipment purchases are included in combined oil/gas property/equipment cash outflows and may be included in machinery/PP&E capex.

children.label: Payments to explore and develop oil and gas properties

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToExploreAndDevelopOilAndGasProperties
concepts.review_reason: Exploration/development cash payments can include exploratory and development drilling and may overlap reported capital expenditures; verify issuer section and exclude expenses already retained in operating cash flow.

children.label: General productive-asset purchase views
children.classification_note: All productive assets contain PP&E and potentially other assets; machinery and residual PP&E/productive asset categories overlap oil/gas spending.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Productive-asset purchases cover PP&E and other productive assets and can contain separately reported oil/gas capex; do not add the aggregate to its components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: PP&E cash purchases may contain oil/gas property, equipment and development spending supplied separately; distinguish acquired mineral interests and internally developed properties.

children.label: Payments to acquire machinery and equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Machinery/equipment payments can include oil/gas equipment and be included in PP&E cash purchases; distinguish the asset population before combining.

children.label: Payments to acquire other property plant and equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Other PP&E purchases are a residual included in broader PP&E or productive-asset purchases; identify exclusions for oil/gas equipment and development.

children.label: Payments To Acquire Other Productive Assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other productive-asset purchases/improvements are a residual of tangible or intangible capital spending; establish exclusions for separately supplied PP&E and intangibles.

children.label: Asset sale receipt views
children.classification_note: Oil/gas property/equipment, PP&E, residual PP&E, all productive assets and formerly productive property held for sale are overlapping use/asset-type views.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of oil and gas property and equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Oil/gas property and equipment sale receipts may be included in PP&E/productive-asset disposal receipts; they are cash proceeds rather than property sale gains.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment
Proceeds From Sale Of Other Property Plant And Equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherPropertyPlantAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Other PP&E sale receipts are residuals within broad PP&E/productive-asset receipts; determine whether oil/gas equipment is already covered.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Productive-asset sale proceeds cover PP&E, software and other intangibles and can contain PP&E-only or formerly productive property sale receipts.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of property held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: These receipts concern formerly productive property held for sale, not an unrestricted category of all inventory property sales; distinguish investment-property and productive-asset receipts.

children.label: Business acquisitions and divestitures
children.classification_note: Acquisition gross/net cash alternatives and business disposal gross/net receipts require consistent acquired/divested cash treatment. Equity consideration is noncash supplementary.

children.label: Business acquisitions, net of acquired cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross acquisition cash payments exclude cash acquired; reconcile them to the net acquisition payment rather than adding gross and net measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses
concepts.review_reason: Gross divestiture proceeds differ from proceeds net of cash divested; establish which disposal cash basis the issuer reports.

children.label: Business divestiture receipts net of cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOfCashDivested
concepts.review_reason: Business divestiture proceeds net of cash divested are an alternative to gross business-sale receipts reconciled with cash removed; do not add both.

children.label: Equity-method and joint-venture cash
children.classification_note: Equity-method/JV purchases can overlap contributions or advances. Return of capital differs from operating distributions from earnings; sale receipts differ from disposal gains.

children.label: Payments to acquire interest in joint venture

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInterestInJointVenture
concepts.review_reason: Joint-venture contributions/advances can overlap equity-method purchases or note lending; identify ownership and loan components before aggregation.

children.label: Equity method distributions return of capital
Investment security cash-flow alternatives
children.classification_note: All-investment purchase/net/sale-maturity-collection totals overlap marketable/maturity/residual views. Cash-equivalent transfers are not automatically investing.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInvestments
concepts.review_reason: All-investment purchases overlap security-class, maturity and other-investment purchase disclosures; select the aggregate or reconciled components.

children.label: Total investment sale, maturity and collection proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: All-investment sale, maturity and collection proceeds include separately mapped portfolios and receipt types; do not add the aggregate to its underlying receipts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireShortTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Short-term investment purchases qualify as investing activity and can include trading securities acquired for investment; they are not purchases of all cash equivalents.

children.label: Marketable security sale and maturity proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Marketable-security sale/maturity proceeds cover HTM or AFS instruments and can include separately mapped AFS receipts; do not assume a separate portfolio.

children.label: Other investing cash
children.classification_note: Investing insurance proceeds relate to investing assets and differ from earnings gains. Residual investing flow is not additive to already included components.

children.label: Proceeds from insurance settlement investing activities

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementInvestingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Insurance settlements classified as investing must relate to investing assets; do not assume the same classification for operating insurance recoveries.

children.label: Other investing payments and proceeds, net

nodes.label: Financing activities
nodes.classification_note: Reported total organizes funding and owner/settlement cash. Instrument, priority and maturity dimensions overlap and must be reconciled.

children.label: Financing cash-flow scopes
children.classification_note: Continuing/discontinued financing totals are scope details of total financing cash flow.

children.label: Borrowing cash flows
children.classification_note: Maturity, seniority, collateral, lender relationship and note form are overlapping axes; net/gross alternatives cannot be summed without a reconciliation.

children.label: Borrowing aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: Gross debt proceeds/repayments overlap components. Net-of-issuance-cost receipts must not be reduced by the same separately reported costs again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt
concepts.review_reason: All-debt issuance proceeds contain maturity, collateral, seniority and instrument-specific amounts and differ from debt receipts net of issuance costs.

children.label: Proceeds From Debt Net Of Issuance Costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Debt proceeds net of issuance costs are an alternative to gross proceeds less separate issuance-cost payments; do not subtract those costs again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebt
concepts.review_reason: Total debt repayments exclude leases and overlap separately supplied maturity, instrument, collateral and seniority views; finance-lease principal is distinct.

children.label: Maturity-based borrowing views
children.classification_note: Long-term, short-term and residual long-term borrowing views overlap instrument/collateral/priority categories; lease principal is separate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Gross short-term debt repayments overlap net short-term borrowing flows; do not combine net and gross presentations without matched proceeds.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of other long term debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other long-term repayments overlap other debt and long-term debt totals as well as the supplied net other-long-term flow.

children.label: Credit-line cash views
children.classification_note: Long-term credit lines are subsets of broader draws/repayments; the net collateralized-line definition differs from all unsecured/secured funding.

children.label: Proceeds From Long Term Lines Of Credit

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Long-term credit-line proceeds are a maturity subset of all credit-line proceeds and may overlap unsecured credit-line receipts.

children.label: Repayments Of Long Term Lines Of Credit

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Long-term credit-line repayments are contained in broader line-of-credit repayments and may overlap secured or unsecured debt repayment views.

children.label: Secured credit-line proceeds and repayments, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Despite the broad name, this net line-of-credit measure is collateralized and spans short- and long-term maturities; it is not equivalent to unsecured-line proceeds.

children.label: Priority, collateral and instrument views
children.classification_note: Senior, convertible, notes, secured and unsecured borrowing views can describe the same instruments. Early senior repayment can be included in senior/long-term debt repayments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfConvertibleDebt
concepts.review_reason: Convertible debt repayments are a subset of long-term debt payments; cash repayment excludes any noncash conversion disclosed separately.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of senior long term debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Senior long-term issuance is a priority/maturity view that can overlap secured/unsecured note and total long-term borrowing receipts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt
concepts.review_reason: Senior long-term debt repayments classify by priority and may overlap secured, total long-term and all-debt repayment views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EarlyRepaymentOfSeniorDebt
concepts.review_reason: Early senior debt repayment is a cash extinguishment of long-term senior borrowing and may be included in senior or total long-term repayments; distinguish principal from separate extinguishment costs.

children.label: Proceeds From Issuance Of Unsecured Debt
Proceeds From Issuance Of Secured Debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSecuredDebt
concepts.review_reason: Secured repayments describe long-term debt by collateral and exclude tax-exempt secured debt; they can overlap long-term and senior repayments.

children.label: Related-party and residual borrowing
children.classification_note: Net related-party debt overlaps gross advances/repayments and is separate from operating trade balances. Residual debt may contain other long-term debt.

children.label: Proceeds From Repayments Of Related Party Debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt
concepts.review_reason: Related-party net debt flow overlaps gross related-party proceeds and repayments; it must be reconciled independently of operating related-party payable changes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other-debt repayments can include other long-term debt; establish residual debt classes before using both tags.

children.label: Finance-lease principal cash
children.classification_note: Lease principal is financing cash; ROU asset obtained and lease commencements are noncash, and interest paid is separately disclosed.

children.label: Equity and ownership cash flows
children.classification_note: All-equity issuance/repurchase totals overlap instrument/plan and contributor views. NCI ownership cash excludes dividends where defined.

children.label: Equity issuance receipts
children.classification_note: All-equity proceeds contain common/preferred/option/warrant and other issuance. IPO, stock-plan and contributor views may overlap common issuance.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance or sale of equity

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquity
concepts.review_reason: All-equity issuance proceeds can contain common, preferred, option, warrant and other equity receipts; select the aggregate or reconciled instrument components.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance initial public offering

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherEquity
concepts.review_reason: Other equity proceeds are a residual contained in all-equity issuance receipts; identify exclusions for common, preferred, options and warrants.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributedCapital
concepts.review_reason: Contributed capital may include affiliate, partnership and common-equity funding; identify contributor and avoid adding overlapping issuance receipts.

children.label: Equity repurchase payments
children.classification_note: All-equity repurchases contain common, preferred and potentially callable preferred amounts; use total or reconciled instrument views.

children.label: Total common and preferred stock repurchases

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity
concepts.review_reason: Total equity repurchase payments overlap common, preferred, other equity and potentially redeemable preferred buybacks; identify which instruments the issuer aggregate includes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemablePreferredStock
concepts.review_reason: Callable preferred stock reacquisitions can overlap preferred and all-equity repurchases; establish the instrument population before combining.

children.label: Noncontrolling ownership cash
children.classification_note: NCI proceeds/payments/redemptions differ from dividends and may overlap owner contributions or retained-control ownership changes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: Noncontrolling funding receipts overlap the net noncontrolling ownership flow; they exclude the separately classified dividend presentation only when reconciled to issuer disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: These payments reduce noncontrolling ownership and exclude dividends; do not combine gross payments with the net noncontrolling ownership flow.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemableNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: Redeemable noncontrolling-interest redemptions can overlap other ownership payments; distinguish redemption from dividends and changes in control.

children.label: Share-award withholding cash
children.classification_note: Tax withholding on net-settled awards is financing cash and differs from award expense and gross issuance proceeds.

children.label: Dividend and capital distribution cash
children.classification_note: Broad distributions include common/preferred/NCI and capital distributions; ordinary dividend totals exclude capital distributions, while recipient views may overlap.

children.label: Distribution aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: Broad distribution and ordinary-dividend totals differ in capital-distribution coverage and overlap narrower recipient views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividends
concepts.review_reason: This cash distribution aggregate includes capital distributions and noncontrolling interests as well as common and preferred dividends; reconcile its scope to ordinary dividends and ownership payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends
concepts.review_reason: Ordinary dividends include common, preferred and noncontrolling recipients, while PaymentsOfDividends can also include capital distributions; reconcile alternative totals.

children.label: Distribution recipient/type views
children.classification_note: Common, preferred and NCI dividends may be ordinary distributions. Capital distributions exclude ordinary dividends and can already be in broad distributions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfCapitalDistribution
concepts.review_reason: Capital distributions exclude ordinary dividends and include special dividends; reconcile them against the broader PaymentsOfDividends cash distribution aggregate.

children.label: Financing costs and contingent consideration cash
children.classification_note: Combined debt/equity costs contain standalone costs; extinguishment cash costs differ from principal and earnings loss. Financing contingent consideration is explicitly section-specific.

children.label: Financing and equity issuance cost payments

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Combined financing and stock issuance cost payments contain debt/financing and equity issuance costs supplied separately; use combined or reconciled separate payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfStockIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Equity issuance costs are included in the combined financing-and-stock-issuance-cost payment amount; select the separate or combined presentation.

children.label: Other financing cash
children.classification_note: Residual financing amounts require issuer exclusions for funding, distributions, issuance costs and contingent consideration.

children.label: Other financing proceeds and payments, net

nodes.label: Cash reconciliation
nodes.classification_note: Match continuing/total cash populations and FX scope. Changes are duration, balances instant, and missing facts are not zero.

children.label: Cash change measures
children.classification_note: Including/excluding-FX total cash/restricted cash changes include disposal groups/discontinued operations under their definitions; they are alternative measures rather than additive.

children.label: Change in total cash and restricted cash including FX
Change in total cash and restricted cash excluding FX
FX effects by cash scope
children.classification_note: Continuing-operation versus total including-discontinued FX measures overlap and must match the selected cash balance/change scope.

children.label: FX effect on cash - continuing operations
FX effect on cash - including discontinued operations
Cash balance scopes
children.classification_note: Continuing cash/restricted cash is contained in the total including disposal/discontinued operations; both are instant balances, not cash flows.

children.label: Cash and restricted cash - continuing operations
Cash and restricted cash - including discontinued operations

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Cash-payment disclosures, ARO rollforwards, noncash events, contract terms and unresolved candidates remain outside primary section calculations.

children.label: Supplemental cash payment disclosures
children.classification_note: Interest and tax amounts are already included in primary cash-flow sections; they are disclosures, not a fourth activity to add.

children.label: Interest cash disclosures
children.classification_note: Gross/net interest cash measures overlap and differ from capitalized/noncash interest; preserve issuer scope.

children.label: Operating interest paid, excluding capitalized interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestPaid
concepts.review_reason: Gross interest paid can contain finance lease interest already disclosed separately; do not add overlapping payment disclosures.

children.label: Tax cash disclosures
children.classification_note: Net, gross, jurisdictional payments and refund receipts overlap; do not add refunds again after choosing net taxes.

children.label: Income taxes paid, net of refunds

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid
concepts.review_reason: Gross income tax payments differ from net-of-refund payments and jurisdiction-specific payment disclosures.

children.label: Income tax paid federal after refund received

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundReceived
concepts.review_reason: Federal tax paid after refunds is a jurisdiction-specific net amount; distinguish it from federal gross payments and all-jurisdiction net tax.

children.label: Income tax paid state and local after refund received

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterRefundReceived
concepts.review_reason: State/local income taxes after refunds are a jurisdictional net subset and are not additional to total income taxes paid net.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds
concepts.review_reason: Tax refunds are cash inflows already netted in IncomeTaxesPaidNet; the disclosure is not an extra receipt to add after selecting a net tax measure.

children.label: ARO rollforwards and noncash events
children.classification_note: Liability additions/revisions/accretion/settlements can include noncash or transfer effects. Only the explicit cash settlement tag establishes cash paid; total balance changes are not cash flows.

children.label: ARO additions and revisions
children.classification_note: Incurred liabilities and revised estimates do not independently establish cash expense or investing expenditure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationLiabilitiesIncurred
concepts.review_reason: ARO liabilities incurred recognize retirement obligations and related asset costs without necessarily involving cash; they are not cash capital expenditures or borrowing proceeds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationRevisionOfEstimate
concepts.review_reason: ARO estimate revisions change the liability and often the asset, rather than representing cash paid or necessarily current earnings; exclude them from cash settlement and automatic operating add-backs.

children.label: ARO settlement rollforward views
children.classification_note: Liabilities settled can include transfers to third parties and noncash settlements; neither equals cash paid to settle without reconciliation.

children.label: ARO liabilities settled or otherwise disposed of

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationLiabilitiesSettled
concepts.review_reason: ARO liabilities settled include obligations otherwise disposed of or transferred on asset sales, so this rollforward amount is not equivalent to cash paid to settle.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SettlementOfAssetRetirementObligationsThroughNoncashPaymentsAmount
concepts.review_reason: ARO settlements through noncash transactions are not cash paid to settle; they can be included in the broader liabilities-settled rollforward.

children.label: ARO balance-change alternatives
children.classification_note: The two total change tags may represent the same carrying-value rollforward and include both cash and noncash events; do not add them.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAssetRetirementObligations
concepts.review_reason: The carrying-value change in ARO includes accretion, revisions, additions, disposals and settlements and can duplicate AssetRetirementObligationPeriodIncreaseDecrease; it is not net cash paid.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationPeriodIncreaseDecrease
concepts.review_reason: The ARO period rollforward includes noncash accretion, revisions and new liabilities and may represent the same change as IncreaseDecreaseInAssetRetirementObligations; it does not establish settlement cash.

children.label: Producing-activity expense disclosures
children.classification_note: Producing-only impairment, DD&A/accretion, ARO accretion and dry-hole costs can already be in consolidated earnings adjustments; activity scopes do not create extra cash-flow add-backs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity impairment is a supplementary activity charge that can already be included in consolidated oil/gas impairment or broad noncash adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationDepletionAmortizationAndAccretion
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity DD&A/accretion is an activity-specific supplementary measure that can overlap total DD&A, depletion and ARO accretion; it is not a second consolidated add-back.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsAccretionOfAssetRetirementObligations
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity ARO accretion can be contained in the activity DD&A/accretion measure and the consolidated ARO accretion add-back.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ResultsOfOperationsDryHoleCosts
concepts.review_reason: Producing-activity dry-hole cost is a supplementary expense that can overlap exploration impairment, abandonment and consolidated noncash adjustments.

children.label: Noncash acquisition and financing
children.classification_note: Values recognized, assumed, exchanged or issued in noncash transactions are not cash acquisition payments, borrowings or equity proceeds.

children.label: Noncash shares and conversions
children.classification_note: Stock/warrant issuance values and instruments converted/issued differ from cash funding; distinguish surrender and issuance sides of conversion.

children.label: Noncash stock and warrants for services or claims

concepts.name: us-gaap:IssuanceOfStockAndWarrantsForServicesOrClaims
concepts.review_reason: Stock or warrants issued for services or claims are noncash settlement values; reconcile any related expense already included in compensation or other earnings adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentAmount1
concepts.review_reason: Value of instruments into which debt is converted in the noncash portion of a transaction; not cash debt repayment or cash equity issuance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConversionOfStockAmountIssued1
concepts.review_reason: The value of instruments issued in a stock conversion is noncash settlement, not equity cash proceeds; it differs from the value of the stock surrendered for conversion.

children.label: Noncash acquisition consideration and liabilities
children.classification_note: Asset fair values, assumed liabilities and issued/issuable equity are valuation/consideration disclosures, not cash acquisition amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FairValueOfAssetsAcquired
concepts.review_reason: Fair value of assets acquired measures acquisition value and can include assets financed through assumed liabilities or equity rather than cash.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilitiesAssumed1
concepts.review_reason: Liabilities assumed can overlap the acquisition-specific and identifiable-liability disclosures; it does not establish repayment cash outflow.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable
concepts.review_reason: Equity interests issued or issuable as acquisition consideration are a noncash component, not cash stock issuance proceeds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionValueOfConsiderationGiven1
concepts.review_reason: Noncash consideration given must be separated from cash acquisition payments and identified by transaction.

children.label: Lease and financing noncash events
children.classification_note: ROU obtained for liabilities, noncash issuance costs and PIK interest differ from capital expenditure, lease principal and cash interest.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForOperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Operating ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities are noncash lease commencements; exclude them from cash capital expenditures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForFinanceLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Finance ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities are noncash lease commencements, separate from principal payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtIssuanceCostsIncurredDuringNoncashOrPartialNoncashTransaction
concepts.review_reason: Debt issuance costs incurred in a noncash or partly noncash transaction are not necessarily cash costs paid in this period; separate their financing and recognition bases.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaidInKindInterest
concepts.review_reason: Paid-in-kind interest is a noncash debt/interest settlement and may be part of the issuer earnings adjustment; do not treat it as cash interest paid.

children.label: Unpaid capital expenditures
children.classification_note: Incurred capex not paid in the period is not current cash spending; reconcile with capital expenditure cash flows only when cash settlement occurs.

children.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred But Not Yet Paid

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalExpendituresIncurredButNotYetPaid
concepts.review_reason: Capital expenditures incurred but not yet paid concern recognition without current-period cash settlement; they can include the separately disclosed unpaid construction expenditures.

children.label: Contractual, balance and discontinued disclosures
children.classification_note: Instant rate/balance amounts, gross debt extinguished and total discontinued cash do not create additional primary flows; discontinued section details are already mapped.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage
concepts.review_reason: The stated debt interest rate is an instant percentage contractual disclosure, not monetary interest paid or an operating adjustment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DividendsPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Dividends payable is an instant liability balance and does not establish cash dividends paid during the period.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredOfferingCosts
concepts.review_reason: Deferred offering costs are an ending asset balance rather than cash paid for equity/debt issuance in this period.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ExtinguishmentOfDebtAmount
concepts.review_reason: Gross debt extinguished can be settled through cash, refinancing or noncash exchanges; it is not a cash repayment measure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontinuedOperations
concepts.review_reason: This is total discontinued operating, investing and financing cash flow; it overlaps the three separately supplied discontinued section totals and is not a fourth activity.

children.label: Candidates requiring issuer reconciliation
children.classification_note: Do not include these candidates in primary section totals until the instrument, portfolio, cash nature and issuer presentation are established.

children.label: Lending and funding cash with unresolved purpose
children.classification_note: Note purchases/collections can be investment or operating portfolios. Private placements do not establish debt/equity instrument; loan origination costs require borrower/lender review.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Note purchases can include mortgage notes and other loans, potentially with accrued interest; establish investment purpose versus resale and overlap with specialized mortgage purchases.

children.label: Proceeds from collection of notes receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Generic note principal collections can involve investment loans or operating assets and overlap broader investment collections; establish portfolio and section.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of private placement

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement
concepts.review_reason: Private-placement capital receipts do not specify debt versus equity in the definition; determine the instrument before assigning to a borrowing or equity issuance family.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfLoanCosts
concepts.review_reason: Loan origination costs paid may overlap debt/financing cost payments; lender-versus-borrower role and issuer presentation must determine section.

children.label: Lease payments used for another asset
children.classification_note: Payments to bring another asset to intended use require capitalization and cash-section review and can overlap ordinary lease payments or asset cash spending.

children.label: Operating lease payments to bring another asset to intended use

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeasePaymentsUse
concepts.review_reason: This operating-lease cash outflow brings another asset to intended condition/location; issuer capitalization and cash-flow presentation determine whether it is included in asset costs or operating lease payments.

children.label: Tax, contingent and financial-service reconciliation candidates
children.classification_note: Deferred tax balance changes and contingent consideration movements are not pure earnings/cash. Financial-service sale gains cannot be remapped to generic oil/gas property gains.

children.label: Change in deferred income tax balances

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Deferred tax balance changes can include acquisitions, OCI and currency effects and do not equal the deferred tax expense add-back.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInAmountOfContingentConsiderationLiability1
